# Play Chess with Chessroom

> A single-page chess information website featuring a guide to browser-based chess, common questions, and a link to play Chessroom.

## Website

- [Chessroom GitHub Pages](https://chessroom.github.io/): Information about playing chess online, chess options, and frequently asked questions.
- [Chessroom](https://chessroom.online/): Main chess game website.

## Notes

This website is a single-page informational resource. The main Chessroom game is available at chessroom.online. Features and game modes should be confirmed on the main website.
